Package org.jwcarman.substrate.mailbox

package org.jwcarman.substrate.mailbox
The Mailbox primitive — a distributed single-delivery future with TTL-based expiration. Contains the Mailbox interface, MailboxFactory for construction, and mailbox-specific exceptions (MailboxExpiredException, MailboxFullException).

Use Mailbox when you need a request-response pattern across distributed nodes — one side creates the mailbox and waits, the other side delivers the single response. See Mailbox for the full contract and usage examples.

    Mailbox<T>
    A distributed single-delivery mailbox with TTL-based expiration.
    MailboxExpiredException
    Thrown when an operation such as Mailbox.deliver(Object) is attempted on a mailbox whose TTL has elapsed or that has been explicitly deleted.
    MailboxFactory
    Factory for constructing and connecting to Mailbox instances.
    MailboxFullException
    Thrown when Mailbox.deliver(Object) is called on a mailbox that has already received its single delivery.
    MailboxNotFoundException
    Thrown when the first operation on a handle obtained from MailboxFactory.connect finds that no mailbox exists at the given name.
